text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Wonder Acute ran.
Without even understanding the reason for the urge, she just ran with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Carrying the spirits of past generations on their back, that running form is—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Accute-san?
...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
She's always been amazing, but
today's run was just...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... Ah, so that's how it is.
Running, I mean...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It is not just for the sake of someone or something else, is it? Indeed... with all of one's might...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Living means... living until you can't
live anymore... And...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm... not done yet...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You were right, Acute-san.
There are still so many things you haven't told me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And... I might not have learned everything yet.
With how I am right now, I still have a long way to go...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? But don't you worry,
it's totally fine. You see...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Tarumae-chan and I still have
plenty of time, after all."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. There's not a single Umamusume...
who can keep running forever and ever, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This won't change. It can't be moved.
Because, you see, we are living beings.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "And when they can no longer run, they disappear from everyone's sight. That is what an Umamusume is..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Once the fire in your body goes out, there's nothin' doing.
When that happens, retirement's the only option.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But you know... I figured it out...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Now is not... that time, they say.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"The fire inside me hasn't gone out.
I can still run, and I still want to run."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I stay like this, I can't say I've truly passed it on to Tarumae-chan.
My life's work...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You were right, Trainer.
I'm still...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I want to run! And I want to win!
Lots and lots, you know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural, isn't it?
If you're hale and hearty, you run.
Even if you're not, you run as best as you can.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know for sure—I can get back on my feet.
Just one more time, one more time...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that what makes a fine Umamusume?
Isn't that what makes a champion?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I can feel it. The fire in my heart is starting to blaze up all over again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A battle against a fading spirit...
I've walked that tightrope... and overcome it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I almost gave up, thinking all that was left was to watch myself decline. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fire had not gone out. Because she didn't yield to comfort,
because she kept driving her own heart forward—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute can start running again from here. Endlessly, longer than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would you pick out a race
for my fresh start?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: At the end of this year, I want to be at the racetrack, not huddled under a kotatsu.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, make sure to invite...
Tarumae-chan too, since she fired me up so much."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The only remaining dirt GⅠ race this year is—
That very race, one of the highest peaks.
choice_data_list: Let's head to the Tokyo Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A fresh start of hope. Wonder Acute
can still shine at the top for a long time yet.
To prove that—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I definitely want to win at the Tokyo Daishoten.
Against Hokko Tarumae, who's visibly
getting closer and closer to becoming the strongest."
